== Acquisition ==
Salvaged by using [[Ascended Salvage Kit]]s and [[Ascended Salvage Tool]]s:
* [[Ascended weapon]]s <small>(guaranteed)</small>
* [[Ascended armor]] <small>(guaranteed)</small>
* [[Ascended trinket|Ascended amulets]] <small>(very low chance)</small>
* [[Ascended trinket|Ascended accessories]] <small>(very low chance)</small>

== Notes ==
* Salvage rate research can be found [[Ball of Dark Energy/Salvage Rate|here]].
* A cheap and straightforward way to get Balls of Dark Energy is to buy an ascended armor piece from [[Raid encounter]]s vendor [[Smoxxi]] and then salvage it with an [[Ascended Salvage Tool]]. e.g. The [[Defender's Chest of Boots]] will cost 150 [[Magnetite Shards]] and 5 gold. [[Crafting]] an ascended armor piece for salvaging is another option, but it's several times more expensive, requires [[Account Bound|account bound]] materials and a respective [[Crafting#Crafting_disciplines|crafting profession]] leveled to 500.
** Another caveat to crafting is that some of the more recently added ascended items ''do not'' appear to have their salvage tables set up correctly, and do not salvage into Balls of Dark Energy. An example of this would be the [[Empowered Boneskinner's Totem]].
* While some [[precursor weapon]]s are of {{rarity|Ascended}} rarity, salvaging them '''does not''' guarantee a Ball of Dark Energy.
